map.双顶径/腹围简化法 EFW ≈ 双顶径×腹围×0.9 − 12；Johnson: BPD/AC simplified EFW ~ BPD*AC*0.9 - 12; Johnson EFW = (AC - 12) * 155; B-ultrasound parameters estimate fetal weight, Hadlock four-parameter most common; estimated weight >= 4000 g is macrosomia.

map.：BPD 9.2cm、HC 33.1cm、AC 31.5cm、FL 7.2cm: : BPD 9.2 cm, HC 33.1 cm, AC 31.5 cm, FL 7.2 cm into Hadlock: log10(EFW) approx 3.49, EFW approx 10^3.49 approx 3100 g, normal weight (2500-4000 g).
map.：若 AC 升至 36cm、BPD 9.8cm，EFW 可超 4000g 触发巨: : if AC rises to 36 cm, BPD 9.8 cm, EFW can exceed 4000 g triggering a macrosomia warning; assess diabetes and shoulder-dystocia risk and plan delivery mode.

map.估算误差有多大？: How large is the estimation error?
map.Hadlock 等公式平均误差约 ±10–15%；胎儿越偏离均值误差越大，临床仅: Hadlock formulas have average error about +-10-15%; the more the fetus deviates from the mean, the larger the error; clinically only a reference, not exact.
map.出生体重 ≥4000g 为巨大儿（部分国家 ≥4500g），与母体糖尿病、过期妊: Birth weight >=4000g is macrosomia (some countries >=4500g), related to maternal diabetes, post-term pregnancy, increasing dystocia and birth injury risk.
